title_en: Cargo handled at Andhra Pradesh ports, 2014-15 to 2025-26
title_te: ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ ఓడరేవుల్లో ఏడాదికి ఎంత సరుకు వచ్చింది, వెళ్లింది (2014-15 నుంచి 2025-26)
why_it_matters_en: People hear that AP ports are booming or that cargo has fallen. These official tables show port by port, year by year, how much cargo was actually handled, and how far the new ports have been built.
why_it_matters_te: ఏపీ ఓడరేవులు బాగా పెరిగాయని, లేదా సరుకు తగ్గిందని వింటుంటాం. ప్రతి ఓడరేవులో ప్రతి ఏడాది నిజంగా ఎంత సరుకు వచ్చిందో, కొత్త ఓడరేవుల పని ఎంతవరకు వచ్చిందో ఈ ప్రభుత్వ లెక్కలు చూపిస్తాయి.

The Mulapeta port page sits at the web path 'bhavanapadu-port' and its company is BPDCL (Bhavanapadu Port Development Corporation Ltd).
Kakinada Gateway Port sits at the web path 'kakinadaSez-port'.
Ramayapatnam progress is printed 'as of 16-Apr-26'. Other progress figures carry no date.
Ramayapatnam 'Likely Completion' is printed as 27-Apr-2026, which is before the read date. The page has not been updated to say if it was met.
caveats_te: ఈ ఓడరేవుల ఖర్చు బోర్డు పేజీల్లో లేదు.
రామాయపట్నం పని శాతం 16-04-2026 నాటిది. మిగతావాటికి తేదీ లేదు.
రామాయపట్నం పూర్తి కావాల్సిన తేదీ 27-04-2026 అని ఉంది. పూర్తయిందో లేదో పేజీ చెప్పలేదు.

caveats_en: The same year appears in several editions. Early figures are often marked provisional and change later. Each edition is kept as printed.

The 31.03.2024 edition prints its table in '000 tonnes. Its text says the 2023-24 total was 199.62 MT and 2022-23 was 175.07 MT, which does not match its own table (199234 and 175182 thousand tonnes). Table values kept.
The April-September 2025 edition is the newest Ministry figure for 2025-26 and covers only half the year. No full-year 2025-26 Ministry figure was found.
caveats_te: ఒకే సంవత్సరం అనేక సంచికల్లో వస్తుంది. మొదట తాత్కాలిక అంకెలు, తర్వాత మారతాయి.
2025-26 పూర్తి సంవత్సరం కేంద్ర అంకెలు ఇంకా దొరకలేదు. సగం సంవత్సరం (ఏప్రిల్-సెప్టెంబర్) మాత్రమే ఉంది.

refresh.how: APMB: fetch https://apmaritime.in/ , read the main script name (now assets/index-DzV6xKA5.js), find the chunk imported for path 'port-performance' (now assets/index-DO-6DhhI.js) and parse the arrays fN, the Visakhapatnam table and the TOTAL AP PORTS table; port pages under assets/<Name>Port-*.js. MoPSW: listing https://shipmin.gov.in/en/transport-reseach/basic-port-statistics for the next 'Basic Port Statistics of India 2025-26' (AP tables: Table 21 or 19 port-wise, Table 3.1.2, Table 3.2.2, Table 3.3.1); Update on Indian Port Sector PDFs appear under https://shipmin.gov.in/sites/default/files/ (no stable listing page found; found via web search).
refresh.cadence: APMB: irregular, a new year column appears after March. BPS: once a year, about 13 months after the year ends (2024-25 edition posted 29-04-2026). Update on Indian Port Sector: twice a year (March and September editions), posted about 6 months after the as-on date.
refresh.notes: APMB numbers are hard-coded in a JavaScript bundle; file names change on every site rebuild, so a refresh must re-discover them. shipmin.gov.in robots.txt asks for Crawl-delay 10; this run waited 10 s between requests. /search/ is disallowed there and was not used.

gaps: No full-year 2025-26 figure from the Ministry yet. Only APMB gives 2025-26 for each port; the Ministry's newest is April to September 2025.
APMB prints a total for all AP ports only for 2024-25 and 2025-26, plus capacity 335.6 with no year. Earlier years' state totals come only from the Ministry.
The APMB 2025-26 total (209.21) cannot be reconciled from the page; what makes up the extra is not stated.
No project cost is printed on the APMB pages for Ramayapatnam, Machilipatnam, Mulapeta or Kakinada Gateway ports. A cost source (state budget, Board annual report or GO) is still needed.
No district-level cargo series exists in these sources. Ports can be tagged to districts by location, but no source table prints that.
Indian Ports Association monthly statistics were not read because ipa.nic.in reset the connection.
Capacity history of the state (non-major) ports by year is not in these sources; only today's capacity per port page.
